downside.summary: EU reserve framework announced with credible supply commitment; weather mild; renewable share surge lifts gas substitution.

upside.summary: Slovakia LNG supply disruption or cold front accelerates; EU emergency gas purchases; power spreads widen.

themes: GB Power premium and storage deficit driving thermal call
EU winter gas shortage fears; strategic reserves framework underway

EU strategic reserve proposal and Russia-Slovakia geopolitical risk create competing signals: supply-stabilization policy vs. LNG disruption tail.

top_takeaway: GB Power at 90th-percentile amid storage 14.6 pp below seasonal norm; geopolitical LNG risk (Slovakia-Russia ties) and EU strategic reserve push create winter supply tail risk.
